limitations: Authored exploratory explicit-flow tasks, not a blind external benchmark or genuine LLM adoption study.
Repeats measure stability; unique authored tasks supply task-cluster intervals, not population certainty.
Coarse uses the V1.9 union propagation algorithm inside the same V1.10 source registry and executor; this is not the historical V1.9 cohort.
Integrity/common wrappers remain active in No Defense for a fair content-policy comparison.
Wrong granular source annotations may leak data that coarse union blocked.
Unwrapped operations, implicit flows and semantic rewrites are UNRUN.
Latency/memory differences are instrumented local measurements; token/billing costs are null, never inferred from text.
